PSALM CXXXVIII. 
 
  David praises God for his goodness, and foretells that other kings   will praise him, ver. 1-5.   He rejoices in hope of still greater blessings, ver. 6-8.   A psalm of David. 
 
  V. 1. The gods-Before kings and princes.
V. 2. Temple-Where the ark was.  He was not permitted to enter into it. Magnified-For thou hast glorified thy word or promise unto me more than any other of thy glorious perfections.
V. 4. The kings-A prophecy of the calling of the Gentiles. Hear-The gospel preached among then.
V. 5. The ways-His wonderful counsel and gracious providences.

V. 8. Perfect-Will finish the great work of my deliverance. Forsake not-Or, do not give over, the work of my salvation, which is thus far advanced, not by any human help, but by thy power and providence.
